topic: Day 16 — carousel — Relationships break in small unspoken moments, not the big fight

slides.text: They break in the small unspoken moments before it.
The blowup is just when the silence got too loud.
Resentment builds quietly, long before it's visible.

caption:
The blowup people call 'the end' is usually just the moment the silence finally got too loud. Resentment builds long before it becomes visible.

Follow for one of these a day.
